task_abi: 192-byte descriptor decoded only with generated replay_control_layout_pkg offsets.
readiness: processing_ready requires source_ready, !dsp_busy and !profile_commit. Wrapper idle additionally requires dispatcher idle and no DSP tail.
profile: External profile_commit explicitly freezes coefficients, RX calibration ID, target matrix ID, Doppler phase ID, FD phase and version. No ID-to-coefficient loading is implied. Commit is blocked while reader owns a task or DSP is busy. task_profiles_valid remains an external proof for all remaining immutable profile references. Head RX/target/Doppler IDs must match committed IDs; fraction_q32 must equal {active_fd_phase,24'd0} exactly.
stream: Real reader raw_data/raw_valid/raw_last feed DSP in_hv/in_valid/in_last directly. DSP performs 2 RXCAL -> 2 FD63 -> target, injects 62 valid zeros after RXCAL, then drains ten FD/target registers. RAW return-token retirement is independent of DSP completion.
cancel: hard_fault, abort, loss of RF/binding/time/clock permission, nonzero real token status, and owner epoch change while reader or DSP active drive DSP hard_fault. This cancels a missing-last underflow and old tails even after RAW token retirement. Restart requires a fresh accepted profile.
phase: External phase_valid/phase_i/phase_q must refer to the current FD-output sampling time at the target input. Doppler lookup and phase timing proof remain external.
latency: 11 register stages plus 31+mu samples FD signal delay. TB phase0 demonstrates 168 GSC ticks at four ticks/sample for this digital chain only. Validated physical DAC/RF latency and RF-plane scheduling remain external inputs; no board latency claim.
ownership: Only frozen_replay_reader produces bank return tokens. Queued rejections require external disposition and never fabricate lease returns. Calibration/profile lifetime must include DSP tail independently of RAW lease retirement.
